name: macos-runner-desktop
description: macOS compute provider desktop tray app with ATProto OAuth + market bidder

storage-dir.description: Directory for key storage and session persistence

oauth-redirect-uri.description: OAuth redirect URI (custom URL scheme, must match fedproxy-hosted client metadata)

ingress-proxy-host.description: XRPC relay dispatcher host for market bidder

plc-directory-url.description: PLC directory URL for DID resolution

firehose-mode.description: Firehose transport: subscriberepos, jetstream, or off

firehose-url.description: Firehose WebSocket URL for RFP discovery (jetstream or subscribeRepos, comma-separated for multiple)

offering-refresh-sec.description: Seconds between offering record re-commits (0 to disable)

skip-market.description: Skip market bidder initialization (escape hatch for npm dep issues)
